resources.string: Change the devices of this paused run
Add or remove helpers and change thread counts, recalculate the plan for the same model, then save. The model and checkpoint stay as they are; the run resumes on the new devices.
Change something, then recalculate. Save needs a plan that fits and is up to date.
The run is active. Pause it before editing its devices.
Only paused runs can be edited.
This run has no saved plan to edit.
The run could not be found.
The new plan would change the model layout, which the saved checkpoint cannot use. Add memory or keep the previous devices.
Devices updated. Resume the run to continue on them.
The previous devices are still configured.
The placement changed, so this phone is pulling the checkpoint parts that the helpers hold. Keep the helpers online until it finishes.
